verdict.rationale: Neon provides real building blocks for autonomous background automation tied to its database: Neon Functions are explicitly pitched as a 'long-running home for AI agents' that stream responses for minutes without lambda-style timeouts, and Neon documents fully automated, unattended project-per-user provisioning/cleanup at scale plus scheduled snapshot creation/restore, driven declaratively via neon.ts and CLI deploy commands. These are genuine autonomous, background-running capabilities rather than just interactive agent assistance, but Functions and AI Gateway are labeled beta, there's no dedicated cron/scheduler UI beyond snapshot scheduling, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirms these automations running unattended in production. Missing for 10: GA (non-beta) status for Functions/AI Gateway, a general-purpose scheduler beyond snapshots, and independent corroboration of autonomous background runs.
